title: La diáspora y la reinvención de la identidad venezolana en el exterior
goal: Analyze the transcontinental reinvention of Venezuelan identity abroad: global arepa diplomacy, music, and professional integration.
grammar: antropología de la diáspora, diplomacia culinaria y patrimonio inmaterial transcontinental

items: Explore the culinary history and global expansion of the arepa (reina pepiada, pelúa, pabellón).
Analyze the active civic, professional, and cultural contributions of the diaspora across host nations.
Deploy diaspora, gastronomy, and cultural identity vocabulary (diáspora, arepa, arraigo, transcultural).
